_doc: Single source of truth for the theme's custom fields. Read by inc/fields.php (native register_post_meta) and by bin/gen-acf.py (acf-json/ + README field map). Types: text textarea wysiwyg number date bool select url image gallery post posts list rows. 'src' says where it comes from in the static site's data. Admin UX keys (bin/gen-acf.py): 'tab' starts an ACF tab at that field, 'instructions' is the help text under the label, 'required', 'choice_labels' (select value -> label). 'ui' on a select: radio or button_group. 'collapsed' on rows: the sub field shown as the row's title when it is folded. The body text of retreat (about), location (intro), teacher and facilitator (bio) is a wysiwyg field, not the post content. 'width' (percent) puts fields side by side on the edit screen.

retreat.label: Start date
retreat.instructions: First day of the retreat. Leave both dates empty for a waitlist retreat (no dates yet). Retreats are listed on the site in date order.

retreat.label: End date
retreat.instructions: Last day of the retreat.

retreat.label: Nights
retreat.instructions: Number of nights, e.g. 6. Used in the page description.

retreat.label: Location
retreat.instructions: The destination page this retreat belongs to. Cards, menus and the location page use it. Type to search. Required.

retreat.label: Place line under the title
retreat.instructions: Optional. The place as the hero shows it, e.g. "Marrakech & Essaouira, Morocco". Leave empty to use the location's display name.

retreat.label: Teachers
retreat.instructions: The teachers who lead this retreat, in the order you want them shown. Search on the left, click to add; drag to reorder.

retreat.label: Facilitators
retreat.instructions: YAWW hosts on the trip. They appear in the hosts tabs next to the teachers. Search on the left, click to add.

retreat.label: Collection
retreat.instructions: Signature Collection or Deep Dives. Sets the label on the card and which collection page lists the retreat.

retreat.label: Booking status
retreat.src: retreats.js status; waitlist = dateless retreat from locations.js program
retreat.instructions: What the badge on the card says. "Spaces left" uses the number below. "Waitlist" is for a retreat with no dates yet. Required.

retreat.label: Spaces left
retreat.instructions: Only used when the status is "Spaces left", e.g. 3 shows "3 spaces left".

retreat.label: WeTravel booking link
retreat.instructions: The WeTravel trip page. Every "Reserve" and "Book now" button on this retreat opens it.

retreat.label: Waitlist note
retreat.instructions: Only for waitlist retreats: the sentence above the waitlist form, e.g. when the last edition ran.

retreat.label: Subtitle
retreat.instructions: One short line under the retreat name on the page, e.g. "A Yoga & Culture Retreat".

retreat.label: About this retreat
retreat.instructions: The introduction under the hero, in the "About" section. One paragraph per block of text; press Enter twice between paragraphs. Bold and links are fine.

retreat.label: Hero photo
retreat.instructions: The large photo at the top of the page (also used when the page is shared). Use a wide landscape photo.

retreat.label: Card photo
retreat.instructions: The portrait photo on retreat cards (312 x 408). Upload it at double size (624 x 816) for sharp screens.

retreat.label: What's included: background photo
retreat.instructions: Optional. The photo behind the "What's included" band. Empty = the default photo.

retreat.label: Included
retreat.instructions: One item per row, as shown in the "Included" list.

retreat.label: Not included
retreat.instructions: One item per row, as shown in the "Not included" list.

retreat.label: Footnotes
retreat.instructions: Optional small print under the lists, one note per row.

retreat.label: Itinerary

sub.label: Photos
sub.instructions: Optional. One or two photos for the day.

retreat.instructions: One row per day (or group of days), in order.

retreat.label: Itinerary notes
retreat.instructions: Optional notes shown under the itinerary, one per row.

retreat.label: Stay description (no hotel names)
retreat.src: BRIEF s.12: e.g. boutique hotel in Chiang Mai
retreat.instructions: A generic description such as "boutique hotel in Chiang Mai". Never write a hotel's name here (Utopia is the only exception).

retreat.label: Accommodations

sub.label: Name
sub.instructions: Generic label, never a hotel name (except Utopia).

sub.label: Tab label
sub.instructions: Short text for the tab. Empty = the name.

retreat.instructions: One row per place you stay. Each row becomes a tab with its photos. Never use hotel names (except Utopia).

retreat.label: Room venues
retreat.instructions: Only for retreats with more than one stay: the venue names, in order, used to group the rooms. Same wording as the Accommodations rows.

retreat.label: Rooms and prices

sub.label: Venue
sub.instructions: Only for retreats with several stays: one of the Room venues. Never a hotel name.

retreat.instructions: One row per room option, cheapest first. The price is per person in USD.

retreat.label: Deposit (USD)
retreat.instructions: Deposit per person shown in "How to book", e.g. 500.

retreat.label: Balance due (days before)
retreat.instructions: How many days before the start the balance is due, e.g. 90.

retreat.label: Roommate note
retreat.instructions: Optional text about shared rooms and roommate matching.

retreat.label: Optional extras

sub.label: Tab label
sub.instructions: Short text for the tab. Empty = the name.

sub.label: Price in USD
sub.instructions: Optional number, used when "Price as shown" is empty.

retreat.instructions: Add-ons guests can book (massages, excursions...). One row per extra; each becomes a tab.

retreat.label: Gallery title
retreat.instructions: Optional. Empty = "Where you'll be".

retreat.label: Gallery intro
retreat.instructions: Optional line under the gallery title. Empty = "Photographs from past retreats in <location>."

retreat.label: Gallery photos
retreat.instructions: Photos for the slider, in order. Drag to reorder.

retreat.label: Guest quotes
retreat.instructions: The "What guests say" quotes. Only real reviews, copied word for word.

retreat.label: Travel tips
retreat.instructions: Groups of tips (getting there, what to pack...). Empty = the location's travel tips.

retreat.label: Additional info (FAQ)
retreat.instructions: Questions and answers shown at the bottom of the page.

retreat.label: Search description
retreat.instructions: Optional. The text Google shows under the title (about 150 characters). Empty = written automatically from the dates, place and teachers.

location.label: Display name
location.instructions: The place as shown in italics on cards and pages, e.g. "Chiang Mai & Koh Lanta, Thailand". Required.

location.label: Short name
location.instructions: The short name on the Locations page and in menus, e.g. "Thailand".

location.label: Card name
location.instructions: Optional shorter place line for retreat cards. Empty = the display name.

location.label: Country
location.instructions: Country name, used for search results.

location.label: Region
location.instructions: Groups the destination in the Locations menu and page. Required.

location.label: Intro title
location.instructions: Title of the "Why we go" section. Its paragraphs are the "Intro text" below.

location.label: Intro text
location.instructions: The paragraphs of the "Why we go" section. Press Enter twice between paragraphs.

location.label: Intro photo
location.instructions: Photo beside the "Why we go" text.

location.label: Grid blurb
location.instructions: Two or three sentences shown on the Locations grid.

location.label: Hero photo
location.instructions: The large photo at the top of the location page (also used when the page is shared).

location.label: Card photo
location.instructions: The photo on the Locations grid.

location.label: Eyebrow
location.instructions: Small line above the title in the hero.

location.label: Tagline
location.instructions: One sentence under the title in the hero.

location.label: Hero facts
location.instructions: Short facts under the hero (e.g. Best time / October). One per row.

location.label: Our guide

sub.label: Placeholder label
sub.instructions: Only when there is no photo yet: what the photo will show.

location.instructions: The guide cards. If you do not have a photo yet, leave Photo empty and fill "Placeholder label".

location.label: Good to know
location.instructions: Label and text pairs (currency, language, weather...).

location.label: Quote
location.instructions: Optional guest quote, word for word.

location.label: Quote: name
location.instructions: Who said it.

location.label: Quote: source
location.instructions: Where it comes from, e.g. "Google review".

location.label: Travel tips
location.instructions: Groups of tips. Retreats here without their own tips show these.

location.label: Gallery photos
location.instructions: Photos for the location gallery, in order.

location.label: Waitlist retreat
location.instructions: The dateless program page (status Waitlist) shown when this place has no upcoming dates.

location.label: Stay description (no hotel names)
location.instructions: Generic, e.g. "boutique hotel by the sea". Never a hotel's name (Utopia is the only exception).

location.label: Placeholder colour (0-360)
location.instructions: Colour of the box shown while a photo is missing. Leave as is.

location.label: Search description
location.instructions: Optional. The text Google shows under the title (about 150 characters). Empty = written automatically.

teacher.label: Role
teacher.instructions: Optional line above the name, e.g. "Yoga teacher". Empty = "Teacher".

teacher.label: Short name
teacher.instructions: First name or short form used in sentences, e.g. "Sue".

teacher.label: Full bio
teacher.src: teachers.js / team.js bio (was the post content)
teacher.instructions: The bio on the teacher page. Press Enter twice between paragraphs.

teacher.label: Card blurb
teacher.instructions: Two or three sentences for the teacher card. The full bio is above.

teacher.label: Bio on retreat pages
teacher.instructions: Optional. The paragraph in the hosts section of retreat pages. Empty = the card blurb.

teacher.label: Quote
teacher.instructions: Optional short quote shown on the teacher page.

teacher.label: Profile not ready
teacher.instructions: Tick while the bio or photo is still missing.

teacher.label: Small round photo
teacher.instructions: Square photo for small round avatars. The large portrait is the "Portrait photo" box on the right.

teacher.label: Photo focus
teacher.instructions: Optional, for portraits that crop badly: CSS position such as "50% 20%" (left-right, top-bottom).

teacher.label: Website link text
teacher.instructions: Optional text for the website link. Empty = the address.

teacher.label: YouTube video
teacher.instructions: A video link or its id. Shown on the teacher page.

teacher.label: Search description
teacher.instructions: Optional. The text Google shows under the title (about 150 characters). Empty = written automatically.

facilitator.label: Role
facilitator.instructions: Line above the name, e.g. "Founder" or "Retreat host".

facilitator.label: Full bio
facilitator.src: teachers.js / team.js bio (was the post content)
facilitator.instructions: The bio on the facilitator page. Press Enter twice between paragraphs.

facilitator.label: Card blurb
facilitator.instructions: Two or three sentences for the card. The full bio is above.

facilitator.label: Show on the Facilitators page
facilitator.instructions: Untick to keep the person off the Facilitators grid (their page still works).

facilitator.label: Photo focus
facilitator.instructions: The portrait itself is the "Portrait photo" box on the right. Optional: a CSS position such as "50% 20%" for portraits that crop badly.

facilitator.label: Search description
facilitator.instructions: Optional. The text Google shows under the title (about 150 characters). Empty = written automatically.

post.label: Date as shown
post.instructions: The date line as readers see it, e.g. "March 2019". Empty = no date line.

post.label: Card photo
post.instructions: Photo on the Journal grid (672 x 406).

post.label: Card photo, double size
post.instructions: Optional 1344 x 812 version of the card photo for sharp screens.

post.label: Top photo, double size
post.instructions: Optional double-size version of the top photo (the photo in the sidebar on the right, under "Journal post").

post.label: Author page
post.instructions: Optional: links the author box to a teacher or facilitator page.

post.label: Author photo
post.instructions: Small round photo in the author box.

post.label: Title
post.instructions: Optional box at the end of the post that points to a retreat. Leave all of this tab empty to hide it.

post.label: Location
post.instructions: The box links to this location page.

post.label: Search title
post.instructions: Optional. The title Google shows, at most 60 characters, ending in "| YAWW" or "| Yoga Adventures Worldwide". Empty = the post title plus the site name.

post.label: Search description
post.instructions: Optional. The text Google shows under the title (about 150 characters). Empty = the excerpt or the start of the post.
